using ai chat to decide how a project fits together before writing code when people hear software architecture it can sound abstract or intimidating in reality its just a conversation about how a project should be organized before everything turns into code what runs first what depends on what what should stay separate so changes dont break everything later you dont need special terms for this you just need to talk through the shape of the project ai chat works especially well here because this discussion does not need to happen inside a code editor it can happen in plain language some examples of useful questions at this stage what are the main parts of this project which parts should not know about each other where does data enter the system what should be easy to change later this kind of conversation often works best in its own dedicated chat think of it as a planning space not a coding space once the structure feels right you can ask the ai to summarize what was decided a short description of the components how they interact and any important constraints that summary becomes the foundation for the actual build at that point it often helps to start a new chat focused on implementation you bring in the architecture summary and place it alongside your project files now the ai is working from a clear blueprint instead of a long exploratory conversation this separation matters more than people expect planning conversations tend to wander explore options and change direction build conversations benefit from focus and clarity keeping them distinct makes it easier for the ai to stay consistent as the code grows for people who are not trying to become software architects this approach removes a lot of pressure you are not learning patterns or frameworks you are making decisions about what you want to build and how the pieces should relate the code ai writes becomes the result of those decisions not the starting point

reading hannah arendt the revolutionary tradition and its lost treasure parts iiiiv on revolution chapter 6 12192025 in this final episode of 2025 roger berkowitz discusses the concluding chapters of hannah arendts on revolution he elaborates on arendts exploration of what she regards as the most mature articulation of her political philosophy particularly focusing on the concepts of freedom and meaningful life the discussion delves into the importance arendt places on public appearance speech and action in a free society contrasting this with mere survival berkowitz highlights arendts views on the american revolutionary institutions like the supreme court and the senate for providing stability and durability but critiques their current failings he outlines arendts admiration for thomas jeffersons ward system as an ideal political structure for fostering public freedom and participation emphasizing the importance of local councils and spontaneous citizen assemblies the episode also touches upon arendts belief in the dangers of corruption arising from the peoples private interests infiltrating public life and the necessity for spaces where true public opinions can be formed the discussion concludes with a look at how this participatory model could be applied today

when high performance creates organizational tension when high performance creates organizational tension a reality many senior professionals experience but rarely discuss in organizations using modern data platform teams high performance often introduces unexpected organizational tension this tension does not arise from poor collaboration or misalignment it emerges from how organizations balance delivery ownership and internal stability when one contributor consistently accelerates outcomes clarifies ambiguity or raises technical standards the system can react defensively what often appears as a people or communication issue is in reality a leadership and incentive problem where the problem actually starts this pattern is most prevalent under managers who lack technical depth and therefore rely on loyalty obedience and personal alignment rather than competence unable to evaluate real engineering quality they optimize for control instead of growth surrounding themselves with compliant team members who pose no intellectual challenge in such environments capability is threatening curiosity is inconvenient and excellence is quietly suppressed to preserve managerial relevance these dynamics are rarely explicit they surface subtly through diluted ownership indirect attribution and the quiet redistribution of meaningful contributions the visibility paradox highly capable contributors often face an unfair tradeoff share openly and risk becoming invisible assert ownership and encounter resistance remain quiet and risk being undervalued this is not a personality issue it is the predictable outcome of leadership structures that prioritize comfort over capability what works in practice design visibility dont assume it highimpact work must be anchored in shared artifacts design documents proofs of concept architecture notes and decision records create clarity continuity and attribution beyond informal conversations tie contribution to measurable outcomes ideas are easily detached from their origin validated results tested approaches and delivered improvements are not outcomes travel further and withstand reinterpretation synthesize in public forums exploration can happen privately conclusions recommendations and decisions belong in shared settings where context and ownership are visible operate with calm documented precision clarity reduces friction professionals who focus on evidence structure and delivery maintain influence without escalating conflict how strong technical leaders behave differently strong technical leaders are not threatened by competence they depend on it they evaluate work based on substance not tone or allegiance they promote people who raise standards not those who preserve comfort they create space for challenge knowing that friction is often a sign of progress they reward documentation transparency and intellectual honesty most importantly they build teams that grow without requiring protection insecure vs strong technical leadership insecure leadershipstrong technical leadership values loyalty over capabilityvalues capability over loyalty avoids technical challengeinvites technical debate relies on private conversationsencourages public synthesis rewards compliancerewards clarity and outcomes feels threatened by high performersleverages high performers optimizes for controloptimizes for growth protects weak performanceelevates team standards confuses harmony with effectivenessbalances trust with rigor lessons learned excellence without visibility is fragile documentation is a leadership tool not overhead attribution follows structure not intent calm alignment outperforms confrontation final thought organizations perform best when competence accountability and recognition are aligned when leadership lacks the ability or willingness to evaluate real work high performers become inconvenient rather than valuable senior professionals who recognize these dynamics early can adapt how they operate protect their contributions and continue delivering impact without being quietly sidelined

drts diffusing alphaemitters radiation therapy dart physical mechanism of action deep dive part 1 series overview this post is part of a series of 3 posts that i envision explaining the overall dart platform this post will explore the physical mechanism of action in depth part 2 will go more into the biological differentiation of the treatment method and part 3 will start to explore comparative positioning both with existing standard of care and other competing alpha particle solutions and i dont do this for a living so please give me a little grace if you discover critical errors in my post if this is information overload and you just want a tldr i suggest an earlier post in our community complete with video how the alpha tau treatment works introduction a new scientific platform for radiation oncology in the field of radiation oncology the fundamental objective has always been to maximize the therapeutic window the ratio between the probability of tumor control and the probability of normal tissue complications the ideal radiotherapy would deliver a highly lethal dose of radiation confined precisely to the tumor volume while completely sparing adjacent healthy tissue for decades this ideal has been pursued through advances in external beam technology and brachytherapy techniques yet the core challenge of radioresistance and collateral toxicity remains a primary limiting factor in clinical practice within this context alphaemitting radionuclides have long been recognized for their exceptional cytotoxicity but their clinical utility in solid tumors has been severely constrained by a fundamental technical hurdle alpha particles possess physical properties that make them in theory a superior form of therapeutic radiation as helium nuclei their substantial mass and 2 charge result in a high rate of energy deposition per unit of path length a characteristic known as high linear energy transfer let this dense energy deposition translates into a high relative biological effectiveness rbe causing complex clustered dna doublestrand breaks that are exceedingly difficult for cancer cells to repair this mechanism of cell kill offers two significant advantages over the lowlet radiation photons electrons used in conventional radiotherapy first its efficacy is largely independent of cellular oxygen levels allowing it to overcome the hypoxiamediated radioresistance prevalent in the core of many solid tumors second it is effective against slow cycling or quiescent cells which are often resistant to standard treatments however the very property that makes alpha particles so potenttheir high letis intrinsically linked to an extremely short path length in tissue typically just 40 to 90 micrometers this physical limitation has historically precluded the use of alpha emitters for the treatment of macroscopic solid tumors an alpha source placed at one point within a tumor could only treat cells within its immediate microscopic vicinity leaving the vast majority of the tumor mass unaffected to unlock the potential of alpha radiation for the majority of cancer patients with solid tumors a novel delivery platform was required to solve this foundational range limitation alpha tau medicals diffusing alphaemitters radiation therapy dart is a platform designed specifically to address and overcome the historical range limitation of alpha particles in solid tumors the technology is based on the intratumoral implantation of a metallic seed containing radium224 ra the novelty of the dart platform lies not in the isotope itself but in the subsequent physical process it initiates as ra decays its first daughter product is radon220 rn an inert gas the recoil energy generated during this decay event is sufficient to eject the rn atom from the surface of the seed and into the tumors interstitial space once free these atoms and their subsequent shortlived alphaemitting daughters diffuse through the tumor tissue this process of recoil and diffusion effectively transforms a static microscopic point source into a dynamic threedimensional therapeutic field a single dart seed can generate a contiguous field of highlet alpha radiation extending several millimeters in diameter an ordersofmagnitude increase over the range of a single alpha particle by arranging multiple seeds a planned conformal and highly potent dose can be delivered to cover the entire tumor volume this unique mechanism gives rise to several key differentiating attributes the treatment effect is derived from physics rather than biological targeting making the platform theoretically tumoragnostic the highly localized delivery and the sharp dose falloff at the edge of the diffusion field are designed to minimize toxicity to surrounding healthy tissues finally the induction of complex dna damage is known to be a potent trigger for immunogenic cell death creating a strong scientific rationale for its use in combination with checkpoint inhibitors and other immunotherapies part 1 mechanism of action physics meets precision to understand the alpha tau dart platform is to first understand its engine the alpha particle the mechanism of action is a direct consequence of fundamental physics which in turn dictates its biological effect and strategic advantages this section deconstructs that mechanism from the properties of the alpha particle itself to the innovative delivery system that finally unlocks its therapeutic potential for solid tumors 11 the power of alpha particles the defining characteristic of an alpha particle in a therapeutic context is its high linear energy transfer let let is a measure of the energy an ionising particle transfers to the material it travels through per unit of distance as heavy particles with a positive charge alpha particles deposit a large amount of energy over a very short distance resulting in a dense track of ionisation for context the let of an alpha particle is approximately 100 kevm which is several hundred times higher than that of the electrons beta particles or photons xraysgamma rays used in conventional radiotherapy this high let gives rise to a high relative biological effectiveness rbe meaning that for a given absorbed dose of radiation alpha particles are significantly more lethal to cells the rbe of alpha particles is estimated to be between 5 and 20 compared to an rbe of 1 for conventional radiation the reason for this heightened lethality lies in the nature of the damage inflicted lowlet radiation creates sparse simple dna breaks primarily singlestrand breaks that cellular repair mechanisms can often fix highlet radiation by contrast creates clusters of complex and irreparable dna doublestrand breaks along its dense track this level of damage overwhelms the cells repair capacity reliably inducing cell death this allows alpha particle therapy to overcome two of the most common mechanisms of clinical radioresistance 1 hypoxia the efficacy of conventional radiotherapy is highly dependent on oxygen alpha particles cause direct physical damage through ionisation a process that does not require oxygen 2 cell cycle the catastrophic dna damage caused by alpha particles is lethal regardless of if the cell is fast or slowgrowing comparative properties of radiation modalities radiation typeparticlelet kevmrbe approxrange in tissueprimary dna damage alpha helium nucleushigh 100 high 520 very short 4090 mcomplex double strand breaks beta electron low 02 low 1 short 0512 mmsinglestrand breaks photon x rayphoton low 02 low 1 long cm singlestrand breaks 12 darts core innovation recoildriven diffusion the central innovation of the dart platform is the method by which it overcomes the profound range limitation of alpha particles the platform leverages the decay chain of radium224 ra to create a system of intratumoral diffusion the process is as follows 1 implantation a sterile stainlesssteel seed approximately 6 mm long is loaded with a specific activity of ra and implanted directly into the target tumor using standard brachytherapy techniques 2 recoil and release ra has a halflife of 36 days upon its initial decay it transforms into radon220 rn an inert noble gas a fundamental principle of nuclear physics dictates that this decay is accompanied by recoil energy this energy is sufficient to physically eject the newly formed rn atom from the surface of the dart seed into the surrounding tumor tissue 3 diffusion and decay cascade once free within the tumors interstitial fluid the rn atoms being chemically inert diffuse outwards from the seed rn has a very short halflife 55 seconds and as it and its subsequent daughter isotopes polonium216 lead212 bismuth212 decay they emit a total of four highenergy alpha particles at various points along their diffusion path this recoilanddiffusion mechanism effectively creates a therapeutic field of alpha radiation that extends approximately 23 millimeters from the seeds surface resulting in a killzone 46 millimeters in diameter this represents a nearly 100fold increase in the therapeutic range compared to a single alpha particle by implanting an array of seeds spaced several millimeters apart a physician can create overlapping killzones to deliver a contiguous ablative dose of alpha radiation across an entire tumor volume 13 dosimetry and spatial control while the diffusion of individual atoms is a random process the aggregate behavior of billions of atoms can be accurately modeled the distribution of the alphaemitting atoms from a dart seed is described by a diffusionleakage model which accounts for the rate of diffusion through tissue and the rate of radioactive decay this model allows for robust and predictable dosimetry enabling clinicians to plan treatments to ensure the entire target volume receives a therapeutic dose a critical feature of this dosimetric profile is the extremely sharp dose falloff at the edge of the therapeutic field because the halflives of the diffusing atoms are short they decay before they can travel far beyond the intended treatment zone the alpha particles they emit have a microscopic range ensuring the cytotoxic effect is highly localized this steep dose gradient is a key safety feature minimizing the radiation dose delivered to adjacent critical structures and healthy tissues this has significant realworld implications potentially allowing for the treatment of tumors that are considered inoperable or unsuitable for conventional radiotherapy due to their proximity to vital organs such as the spinal cord major blood vessels or optic nerve the ability to deliver a highly ablative dose with such spatial precision is a core component of the dart platforms if this sort of blog series post isnt allowed ello im m charles it occurred to me that some people might enjoy this process its one of those popular dev diary posts or design logs however instead of giving a general overview of the process after the fact im showing you practically every single step i took from start to finish in real time youre actually a little behind at the moment but not by much note when i use the word likely before inspired by im referring to the fact that i was almost certainly subconsciously influenced by whatever is being referenced at least to my recollection on the other hand if i simply say inspired by that means i was actively consciously inspired or influenced by whatever is being referenced and i didnt keep notes since i didnt come up with the idea for dev posts until later so this is all from memory note im very sick as i write all of this but it did give me time to think and slowly piece the game concept together so how did i get here part i just zombies and what kind of game is it ever since a prior project ive had zombies on the brain pun intended since then however zombies have become a bit tired theyre still popular and have a strong following but many gamers are off them and the market is deemed somewhat saturated with them and a certain sour element exists for the euro gamers thanks to the generally ameritrash nature of zombiethemed games lucky for me and now for you im an ameritrash gamer at heart in my defence i was pairing zombies with a scifi space opera and they were space zombies that is quite a unique idea lets pause for a moment and return to another game i had the idea of creating some kind of scifi dungeon crawlroguelike game inspired by necromunda 2017 i later realised that i couldnt make a good ai and the crossfire 1996inspired turnless objectivetoobjective movementaction system was less than ideal for what i was working with jump to late 2025 and it hit me i could create more of a board game dungeon crawl and use the crossfire system at least thats my current thinking and the backdrop for this system shadows of brimstone of course part ii the first steps into the darkness and into a truly original idea the first thing to know is that i just kind of sat with the game for about 20 days all i really knew to begin with was that i wanted a roguelite framework a crossfire system ie there are no set ranges or actions or orders etc you do what you want until you fail causing a turnover there are some rules of course but its more playerchoice and sandboxy than is usually the case shadows of brimstone revised edition 2020 to some degree when i say truly original idea i dont mean unique or better than other devs i simply mean the sort of idea that makes you think that youre really creating something interesting and playable for me that began with the american civil war springboarding off shadows of brimstone i first came up with the idea to use ghoullike miniatures to represent fallen soldiers on both sides red bases south blue bases north i gave them different abilities they were supposed to be the ghosts of the soldiers trapped in a battle with each other in some kind of alien vs predator 2004 fashion you were a mystic clan cowboy outlaw and as you moved through the mine you had to battle these two enemies equally interesting concept not good enough and possibly too close to how shadows of brimstone actually functions that was the 1st step the game was titled horrors from the deep since the boss at this time was the cave dragon and the enemies were called horrors i dont want to get stuck in the weeds but i can show you the rough draft covers i tried a few different tonal directions story directions and core gameplay directions at first time i wanted a more zombicide 2012 framework mapped onto sob the universal change however was from cowboy to landpirate and the addition of a second game for the homebrewsupervariant merchants marauders 2010 i still wasnt certain on the nature of the zombies or lack thereof the second draft became horror from the deep omitting the pluralisation of horror ill show the subtitles and taglines too cover 1 horror from the deep a merchants marauders shadows of brimstone homebrew tagline roguelite old west pirates cover 2 shadows of the marauders a solo shadows of brimstone and merchants marauders homebrew cover 3 sleepy dungeons a sandbox roguelite tagline a solo multigame homebrew shadows of brimstone and merchants marauders cover 4 sleepy dungeons a solo shadows of brimstone and merchants marauders homebrew cover 5 sleepy dungeons a roguelite tagline a multifaceted solo homebrew shadows of brimstone merchants marauders dead cells crossfire 40 winks der sandmann labyrinth the princess bride part iii the slow shift to another world cover 1 shows that i combined pirates with the old west but it doesnt show how i actually ended up with dungeon trawler what does american civil war landpirates have to do with pirates trawling deadly fish deep underground nothing is the answer the missing link is cover 2 a wild idea entered my mind and i soon realised that i actually wanted this wild idea i replaced the old west miniatures from shadows of brimstone with a ship miniature from merchants marauders the idea simple instead of going through dungeonscaves on foot you would sail through vast underground lakes on ships the american civil war gag was still intact however lets jump to cover 5 this shows the second major shift one towards the sandman folklore and 40 winks 1999 ps1 video game the connection here is the dreamworld given the absurd nature of sailing through dungeons as cowboy landpirates i somehow had the idea to shape it into 40 winks 1999 where you would actually be small children trapped in a dream that idea didnt last very long but it was a very powerful springboard and along the way i decided to adhere relatively closely to games like dead cells more roguelike in nature thematically and tonally i also shifted with cover 3 to a more playful satirical direction inspired by labyrinth 1986 and the princess bride 1987 via blood bowl this was already on my mind since i planned to use their term turnover given the blood bowllike nature of the turn system via crossfire i already had the idea for a satirical fantasy sports game some time ago too but that idea failed for solo play as is often the case the shift was thanks to the sleepy dungeons direction that came from the fact that i had the idea to keep the enemies sleeping in the dungeons i thought this would be a neat way to allow the player to choose to encounter a deadly enemy they had good loot which meant risking it was worth it sometimes but they were powerful enough that being forced to encounter them every single time would cause death and become boring however this title was in conflict were the enemies sleeping or the player or both this meta situation almost led to an inception 2010 structure where you would enter the dreams of the enemies such as vampires no im not joking but i scrapped that idea due to it being a little too on the nose and needlessly complicated however i stuck with the dream concept part iv finding the title and the cover but how did i get to dungeon trawler just another little shift thats all i aged up the children avatars from before and exchanged the sandman for my own fisherman analogue i got rid of the american civil war factor and removed most of the old west connections this helped to unify everything but it also ensured that the game was a little more agnostic in terms of miniatures themes and components just in case you didnt own one of the games or wanted to take it in a space opera direction though cowboys in space is a thing as i stated earlier i kept the dream concept but fixed it to the fisherman character in relation to the player the nownamed old vampires were still sleeping too in some fiction this is exactly what old vampires do they were optional to fight but offered great rewards in the first place the sandman character went in a bit of a coraline 2009 direction you had to collect monster child eyes as a point system if you escaped the dungeon there were a few conflicts to fix marry combine or nest was the monster child eyes thing a bit too grossscary for a familydriven game what does this have to do with the fishing mechanic where does fishing fit into this is it acceptable to just reuse sandman mythology and insert it into this otherwise unrelated setting is there mining on foot do you get off the ship what happens when following but many gamers are off them and the market is deemed somewhat saturated with them and a certain sour element exists for the euro gamers thanks to the generally ameritrash nature of zombiethemed games lucky for me and now for you im an ameritrash gamer at heart in my defence i was pairing zombies with a scifi space opera and they were space zombies that is quite a unique idea lets pause for a moment and return to another game i had the idea of creating some kind of scifi dungeon crawlroguelike game inspired by necromunda 2017 i later realised that i couldnt make a good ai and the crossfire 1996inspired turnless objectivetoobjective movementaction system was less than ideal for what i was working with jump to late 2025 and it hit me i could create more of a board game dungeon crawl and use the crossfire system at least thats my current thinking and the backdrop for this system shadows of brimstone of course part ii the first steps into the darkness and into a truly original idea the first thing to know is that i just kind of sat with the game for about 20 days all i really knew to begin with was that i wanted a roguelite framework a crossfire system ie there are no set ranges or actions or orders etc you do what you want until you fail causing a turnover there are some rules of course but its more playerchoice and sandboxy than is usually the case shadows of brimstone revised edition 2020 to some degree when i say truly original idea i dont mean unique or better than other devs i simply mean the sort of idea that makes you think that youre really creating something interesting and playable for me that began with the american civil war springboarding off shadows of brimstone i first came up with the idea to use ghoullike miniatures to represent fallen soldiers on both sides red bases south blue bases north i gave them different abilities they were supposed to be the ghosts of the soldiers trapped in a battle with each other in some kind of alien vs predator 2004 fashion you were a mystic clan cowboy outlaw and as you moved through the mine you had to battle these two enemies equally interesting concept not good enough and possibly too close to how shadows of brimstone actually functions that was the 1st step the game was titled horrors from the deep since the boss at this time was the cave dragon and the enemies were called horrors i dont want to get stuck in the weeds but i can show you the rough draft covers i tried a few different tonal directions story directions and core gameplay directions at first time i wanted a more zombicide 2012 framework mapped onto sob the universal change however was from cowboy to landpirate and the addition of a second game for the homebrewsupervariant merchants marauders 2010 i still wasnt certain merchants marauders shadows of brimstone homebrew tagline roguelite old west pirates cover 2 shadows of the marauders a solo shadows of brimstone and merchants marauders homebrew cover 3 sleepy west miniatures from shadows of brimstone with a ship miniature from merchants marauders the idea simple instead of going through dungeonscaves on foot you would sail through vast underground lakes on new new people new expectations new pressures familiarity is grounding in this constant novelty it acts like a small island of certainty with familiar food you know how it tastes you know how it will make you feel theres no learning curve this predictability aids busy city lives to such a preference hungersate fits in naturally it doesnt treat familiarity as boring it treats it as necessary solo living and solo eating city living too often means living alone even when people share homes schedules rarely align eating together becomes occasional not daily this changes the social and emotional function of food meals are no longer performances or gatherings they are personal moments hungersate supports this shift without judgment the portions make sense theres no assumption of sharing no pressure to turn every meal into an event eating alone becomes normal and not lonely late nights irregular hours cities dont sleep uniformly some people start their day early others end it late eating patterns are reshaped by night shifts creative work global time zones and long hours traditional food systems struggle with this irregularity hungersate supports city lives in tune with these uneven hours food becomes accessible even when schedules may be unconventional this flexibility means people eat when their bodies ask for it not when the systems allow it emotional exhaustion requires gentle food city life silently drains emotional energy long queues noise crowds and a continuous negotiation for space and attention most people by the end of the day are emotionally exhaustedthey just cant quite name why food becomes emotional support in these moments not indulgent food necessarily just food that doesnt add stress hungersate reinforces this necessity in the form of food that feels safe and comforting food that doesnt surprise food that understands exhaustion the small rituals that keep people sane even amidst chaos people make rituals a regular order for lunch a set dinner option for challenging days a particular dish to signal the end of work these rituals bring structure into otherwise unpredictable days hungersate becomes part of these personal rituals these small habits are what over time anchor busy city lives they create moments of predictability when very little else feels predictable food without performance pressure cities are great amplifiers of performance how you dress where you eat what you post food can easily become a part of this performance but daily city eating rarely wants an audience hungersate supports private unperformed eating meals arent for sharing shots of or reviewing theyre for quietly eating this return to personal eating seems like relief for many city dwellers supporting health without obsession city lives dont leave much room for rigid food rules people want to eat well but they do want flexibility some days are balanced some are chaotic it echoes this very realistic approach towards health where food is not moralized it does not punish indulgence nor praise restriction food becomes part of life not some kind of separate project trust matters much more than speed alone city platforms often compete on speed faster delivery shorter wait times but speed without trust causes anxiety people want to believe that food is going to arrive correctly taste familiar and not disrupt their day this can be accomplished through consistency rather than urgency over time such reliability becomes part of how people structure their days trust becomes support the unspoken role of food in city survival food keeps city lives moving it fills gaps it stabilizes moods it supports focus it provides moments of rest this role is rarely acknowledged yet deeply felt it does this by recognizing what part it plays in busy city lives keeping aligned with that role by fitting into habits not reshaping them aggressively flexibility over ideals city life constantly breaks ideals perfect meal times homecooked dinners every night and balanced plates daily people learn to let go of these ideals in favor of sustainability this flexibility is supported by hungersate it doesnt require perfection it supports survival gently food as quiet infrastructure in cities infrastructure counts roads transport internet food platforms are increasingly becoming part of that infrastructure they dont attract any attention when they work well they simply support life hungersate functions in this quiet way supporting busy lives without demanding acknowledgment why this support feels natural hungersate does not feel like an interruption in city life rather it is an extension of it it understands unpredictability it respects fatigue it accommodates change it is this understanding that makes the support feel human and not transactional faqs 1 why do more citydwellers depend on food platforms these days a busy schedule long commutes and mental exhaustion make flexible food access more necessary than optional 2 does utilizing food platforms diminish healthy eating not necessarily many use platforms for regular balanced meals when cooking isnt possible 3 how does hungersate suit irregular city schedules it offers flexibility and familiarity instead of having to follow fixed routines people can eat at times that their day allows 4 is hungersate only about convenience no it supports emotional comfort routine and reliability too in fastpaced city environments

why some tradies prefer newer job marketplaces in australias growing tradie economy bigger doesnt always mean better while wellknown platforms like hipages and oneflare are still widely used many tradies are starting to explore newer job marketplaces that feel more balanced and easier to work with one common reason is competition tradies often share that on established platforms the same job can be sent to a large number of businesses this can turn quoting into a numbers game with time spent responding to jobs that dont always lead anywhere some tradies also mention that it can be hard to stand out when youre competing with dozens of similar profiles in the same area newer marketplaces tend to take a more focused approach jobs are shown to fewer more relevant tradies which can lead to better conversations and higherquality enquiries this is where platforms like servicetasker are gaining attention by matching tasks with verified tradies who are likely to quote the process feels more targeted rather than crowded cost control is another big factor many tradies say they want flexibility especially when workloads change week to week servicetaskers payasyougo credit system allows tradies to choose which jobs to engage with making spending more predictable and easier to manage trust also plays a major role servicetasker places strong emphasis on verification including abn and licence checks which helps customers feel confident and gives genuine tradies a chance to stand out clear messaging tools and a straightforward workflow also reduce backandforth and save time this shift doesnt mean established platforms no longer work instead it highlights how the marketplace is evolving newer platforms like servicetasker are reshaping the tradie space by focusing on relevance transparency and fair engagement which is why more aussie tradies are giving them a go

documenting everyday racism in berlin germany and the eu as an indian guy tldr despite being educated integrated and financially stable constant racial microaggressions are experienced in berlin from everyday people even in liberal spaces and this behavior has increased noticeably recently disclaimer 1 long read background i 28m am a data analyst from punjab india i have been in germany since 2021 2021 2023 masters degree in mannheim 2023 present a data analyst job with a blue card in berlin i make over 60k euros annually and pay over 1100 euros rent in a neubau in the city centre thus surrounded by tourists non locals and i speak 35 languages half for b1 german lol why is this my first post why is my account empty i have been using reddit for years but never had anything interesting useful to share use it for memes and football gossip mostly ready to have my identity verified if mods would like to check recently i have observed a widespread uptick in racist behaviour amongst the city dwellers which made me document all possible microaggressions of my years living here which i shall like to share for potential bipoc folk who may wanna move to berlin germanyeu 1 reflexive theft check people visibly clutch and secure their belongings when i pass by purse grips and pocket checks regardless of age or ideology it happens on roads in public transport and now increasingly in shopping malls its frequent subtle and deeply insulting this happens almost every day these days and is the most noted impulsive racist behaviour that one has to encounter daily 2 selective border harassment on a train from budapest to munich sep 2025 border security singled us out for checks and verbal abuse including photographing me and my parents passports on a personal phone standard process now a days but looks unprofessional digitalisierung a chinese family seated next to us was not checked at all when i calmly asked in german whether taking photos was permitted the interaction escalated immediately with multiple armed officers with guns of course responding aggressively no bystanders intervened or reacted we were treated like criminals despite having spent thousands of euros on the trip needless to say my parents wont ever visit europe again 3 medical dismissal doctors dismiss nonlocals pain or concerns as exaggeration or system abuse a sprained ankle took over a year to treat i couldnt get crutches one doctor mocked me and my cousins high ranking professional at a major automotive sixyearold had to go to india for autism testing because local doctors claimed he was faking it or nothing could be done 4 baseless theft accusation at a bollywood party a white german guest accused me of stealing his wallet while i was dancing bouncers and the organizer my friend who invested heavily in the event had to intervene turns out his drunk or drugged self had just dropped it did he apologize no i didnt argue to avoid ruining the night this incident6 june 2025 panke club berlinwas when i started tracking such events past and future the bouncers were cordial and respectful kudos to them 5 public accusation on a bus a girl on a bus openly accused me of stealing her phone saying ich muss mein handy checken ob es geklaut wird as i walked by locking eyes with me my german friend and others heard it and nothing happened but no one objected either signaling that racial profiling is just another tuesday here 6 drug dealer stereotype in the supposed liberal opentoall berlin ive lost count of how many times ive been asked if i sell drugs at clubs and bars 7 alarmed parents around kids people sometimes hold their kids tightly when i walk by treating me like a potential kidnapper at wannsee july 2025 i saw a family quickly take away a single football as if a 10 ballor a childwas somehow at risk from a nonwhite stranger its a constant subtle reminder of who is considered safe in public spaces 8 racial profiling at retail stores alarm bells and random security checks have targeted me three times at decathlon alexanderplatz each time a security guard rifled through my belongings while bystanders watched and smirked leaving me humiliated after spending hundreds of euros there over the years 9 patronizing bekannte and visa quizzes socalled bekannte lecture me about the brgergeld system treating me like a potential fraud while indirectly questioning my visa status even though they know i earn more and am better educated than them this often happens at dinner parties hosted by self proclaimed liberal folk who are still exploring at 3540 years of age 10 bicycle surveillance and distrust simply unlocking my own bicycle sometimes draws stares and questions as if a 200 bike is too much for a nonwhite person to own ive been interrogated twice by people who we share an office with another firm treated like a thief despite there being no reason for suspicion this white knight behavior is borderline obnoxious 11 robbed and accused in mannheim july 2022 i was pushed off my bicycle and robbed of my money late at night in a lane known for drug activitya naive mistake my bike was damaged and i was left bruised and shaking dragging it to the tram shortly after a local slowed down in his car and asked ist das dein fahrrad gehrt zu dir i had to explain to him that it was minemy first interaction with the seedy side of racism in this country 12 public humiliation at parties security and socalled awareness teams were called on a man simply for dancing with his own date leaving him embarrassed in front of dozens of people the girl was white the man was not and he didnt speak up so his date had to defend him i witnessed this and stayed silent too lets be honest instinctively it signals that your social standing in this country is heavily influenced by your skin color perceived heritage or country of origin 13 verbal harassment in public in neuklln random teenagers who were nonwhite and drunk or drugged white people have yelled things like wallehkum salaam go back to pakistan at me even though i am neither muslim nor from pakistan 14 liberal hypocrisy and racialized politics beyond official rhetoric framing nonwhite people as threats or rapists by chancellor merz himself stadtbild fragen ihre tchter etc banners and posters promoting remigration were visible everywhere last year selfproclaimed liberal types use antiafd statements to signal virtue while continuing to act racist judging and treating people as different based on origin socalled openminded people often provide little real protection from bias and their activism is only for instagram from what i have seen disclaimer 2 in the following points my own biases have crept in for sure this isnt a peer reviewed journal 1 condescension in fast food restaurants people at starbucks subway dominos and mcdonalds often act overly condescending explaining basic choices as if speaking to a toddler its treated as though its the first time anyone from a certain background is in a chain fastfood restaurant aplenty of this comes from bipoc folk actually who assume you to be some kind of poor refugee in this liberal utopia or dystopia 2 social avoidance in public transport no one sits next to you on re trains buses ubahn sbahn or in movie theaters people sometimes even prefer to sit next to literal homeless individuals hard to confirm and potential bias may creep in but its worth mentioning as an observation shared by many around me as well 3 conditional courtesy at supermarkets cashiers greet warmly when youre with a white friends but not when youre alone or with another indian any delay at checkout is met with eyerolls shoppers tighten their grip on purses and carts midaisle as if im going to steal their tomatoes which they havent even paid for yet even routine supermarket trips have become exercises in racial profiling mostly happens at the aldi and rewe near my office and where i live this doesnt happen often to be noted 4 unjustified judgments a local friend introduced me to his parents and they were completely dismissive and rude acting as if i were the negative influence on their son this discrimination kinda indicates that no amount of learning german getting good jobs or education etc can convince people otherwise you are inferior inherently and will be treated as such final verdict contrary to popular belief ive never had issues with the auslnderbehrde finanzamt brgeramt or police or even apartment hunting all my negative experiences come from everyday people who claim to have moved on from the pastbut clearly havent in the past two years in the socalled most liberal city in europe ive been typecast at the slightest inconvenience as a thief rapist criminal lazyunemployed jobstealer drug dealer kidnapper misogynist or brgergeld abuserall at once and this is while being one of the good ones i can hardly imagine what the bad ones face this racism doesnt come from some rural fringeit comes from supposedly leftwing educated welltraveled liberal young people the ones with tattoos colored hair fancy earrings and rich parents who show bias at yoga studios tantra retreats holi and diwali festivals bollywood parties and meditation sessions all while chanting say no to racism meanwhile friends in india dubai the us australia and canada are buying properties starting companies raising funding getting married and running for local elections here i simply hope a day passes without racial profiling thanks for reading this super long post in short life as a bipoc person isnt as rosy as it may seem and the recent rise in rightwing activity needs to be addressed much more seriously

how to play offline christmas games virtually christmas is all about togetherness laughter and shared moments but what if your friends family or colleagues are in different cities or even different countries the good news is that you dont have to give up your favorite offline christmas games with a little creativity and the right tools you can easily play traditional christmas games virtually and still enjoy the festive spirit i have written this article to explain to you how to play offline christmas games online step by step using simple methods that work well for virtual parties on platforms like zoom google meet or microsoft teams why play offline christmas games virtually offline christmas games are familiar fun and easy to understand when moved online they help people feel connected during the holidays reduce screen fatigue compared to complex online games work well for all age groups require little to no cost virtual versions of offline games are perfect for family gatherings office christmas parties and friend meetups tools you need to get started you dont need advanced software to play offline christmas games virtually most games work with basic tools such as video conferencing apps zoom google meet microsoft teams a stable internet connection pen and paper or printable sheets a timer mobile phone or online timer optional tools like screen sharing and chat boxes can make the best christmas games more interactive how to convert offline christmas games into virtual games the key idea is simple keep the rules the same and change the format below are practical ways to adapt common offline christmas games for virtual play 1 christmas charades virtual version charades is one of the easiest games to play online how to play virtually divide players into teams the host sends a christmasthemed word privately to the acting player the player acts it out on camera without speaking the team guesses within a time limit you can use classic christmas themes like movies songs traditions or characters 2 guess the christmas song this game works perfectly for virtual settings how to play virtually one player hums or plays a short instrumental version of a christmas song others guess the song name using chat or voice set a time limit for each round to avoid sound issues keep the volume low and test the audio before starting 3 christmas trivia quiz trivia is a great way to include many players at once how to play virtually prepare christmasrelated questions in advance the host asks questions aloud players answer via chat or pen and paper give points for correct answers questions can include christmas movies traditions food and history 4 show and tell christmas edition this is a calm and meaningful game especially for families how to play virtually ask players to bring a christmas item decoration gift photo each person explains why it is special others can ask questions or react this game builds emotional connection and works well for mixed age groups 5 christmas scavenger hunt at home you dont need a shared physical space for a scavenger hunt how to play virtually the host calls out christmasrelated items players search their homes and show the item on camera the first person back gets a point examples include a red ornament a santa hat a candle or a christmas card 6 pictionary with a christmas twist pictionary can be easily played using a whiteboard or paper how to play virtually one player draws a christmasrelated word share the drawing on the camera or virtual whiteboard others guess within a set time keep words simple to avoid confusion and maintain pace tips to make virtual christmas games more fun to make your virtual christmas games successful follow these best practices keep rules simple so everyone understands quickly set clear time limits to avoid delays encourage camera use for better interaction use festive backgrounds or dress codes choose a host to manage the flow of games short breaks between games also help maintain energy common mistakes to avoid while playing offline christmas games virtually avoid long explanations that reduce excitement technical overload with too many tools games that require physical contact ignoring time zones when scheduling testing the setup once before the event can prevent most issues best games to choose for virtual christmas parties if you are unsure where to start focus on games that need minimal materials they are easy to explain works well with video and audio you can explore a curated list of the best fun christmas games that can be easily adapted for virtual play and suit different group sizes final words playing offline christmas games virtually is a simple and joyful way to stay connected during the holiday season with basic tools clear rules and a little planning traditional games can feel just as fun online as they do in person whether its a family gathering a friends meetup or a virtual office party these games help create laughter warmth and lasting christmas memories virtual celebrations may look different but the holiday spirit remains the same shared smiles friendly competition and quality time together

routed through an organized consolidation setup like vanguard logistics coordinated locally by qfm shipping what is lcl and when it makes sense lcl means your cargo shares a container with shipments from other exporters you pay only for the space your cargo uses cbm or weight lcl is ideal if your shipment is roughly 115 cbm you ship regularly but not full containers you want scheduled sailings instead of adhoc space you need predictable handling at both origin and destination typical pakistan usa lcl flow 1 cargo pickup or delivery to the origin facility in pakistan 2 measurement weighing and consolidation under defined cutoffs 3 ocean freight via planned lcl sailings 4 us arrival deconsolidation at a cfs container freight station 5 final delivery to your buyer or warehouse or cfs pickup most delays happen when documents dimensions or cutoffs are not managed properlynot because lcl itself is slow why the consolidation network matters lcl is all about process discipline a strong network helps ensure consistent cutoffs proper cargo matching in containers cleaner documentation faster deconsolidation at destination thats why many exporters and forwarders prefer vanguard logistics global lcl network with qfm shipping handling pakistanside coordination common mistakes to avoid underdeclaring cargo size cbm always gets remeasured weak packaging lcl cargo is handled more residue chipped paint oxidised metal soot patterns and panel discoloration have all been crafted inspired by realworld examples not only observed on the tristar but other inservice aircraft which have sense of operational history subtle material roughness changes variation in reflectivity and dirt accumulation around seams and rivets create a realistic appearance that reflects decades of service life stairs and lounge feature although the l1011500 variant did not operate with the lower lounge feature the concept is so iconic that we created our own retrofit for simmers to enjoy this will be available as an optional preset configuration of the aircraft within msfs the optional lounge includes a fully modelled lower deck with a bar area seating and relaxation spaces and a spiral staircase that connects the lower lounge to the main cabin most notably the exterior boarding stairs lead directly into the lounge from the outside of the aircraft giving the unique experience of a private jet style boarding flow for a widebody airliner we have also included the distinctive lower forward lobe on the aircraft belly only tristars equipped with the lounge had this structure it was designed to protect passengers in the lounge area in the event of a heavy landing that could compromise the nose gear this additional detail is recreated accurately in our retrofit version and represents a unique identifying feature of loungeequipped tristars we hope to showcase the cockpit interior and additional features in our next development update optimisation and performance visual quality is balanced excerpt from lived experience to the written word reconstructing practical knowledge in the early modern world by pamela h smith 2 the metalworkers philosophy i chapter 2 the metalworkers philosophy butter when the heirs of the augsburg merchant christoph fugger commissioned a gilded bronze altar in the dominican church of st magdalena in 1581 fig 21 they could have had no idea that it would take three long and troubled years to complete an account book records the material side of this processthe artisans paid the raw materials bought and a number of surprising entries for the purchase of butter this chapter investigates what metalworkers did with all those pounds of butter many foodstuffs were part of making processes like the soft bread used to erase drawings the crushed garlic employed in mordant gilding or the fishbones and fig juice used as glue provisions for workers nourishment such as beer were also recorded in many contracts were these metalworkers eating the butter or were they using it in making the sculpture the contract notes that the butter was purchased for the gilders against the evil smoke what might this signify in this chapter i survey many instances of butter in workshop accounts and technical recipes with the aim of understanding how a connection between butter and noxious fumes could have emerged out of the metalworking shop i delineate a material imaginary in order to reconstruct the worldview in which materials generated meaning through their use i seek to understand how artisanal practices and techniques were informed by a deeper systemic understanding of materials this chapter shows that in early modern workshops making with natural materials could also be about investigating and knowing the fundamental properties and behavior of natural materials well into the nineteenth century artisans remained the preeminent experts on the processes of nature and the manipulation of natural materials however even sympathetic historians and theorists of craft have downplayed the view that such making can be knowing or theorizing or philosophizing or that it can be regarded as a knowledge system the foremost editor of metalworking discord causes stutters in deadlock and i have proof hello everyone while i was aware of discord causing issues for many gamers i never saw any raw data backing it up however having had stutters while playing deadlock i decided to investigate the issues following this guide to event tracing for windows written by a valve employee for cs2 i decided to trace for any negative interactions between discord and deadlock from this i have gathered enough data to confidently back up the claim that discord no matter what your settings are may cause stutters at least on a 4 core machine i can back this up due to having made five event traces where only three major programs were running deadlock plus steam discord and perfview the profiler that was tracing my system in all five of these traces the cpu usage of discord rapidly goes up for a brief period of time around 100 milliseconds coinciding with deadlocks cpu usage going down for around 100 ms the game not showing any updates for around 100 milliseconds in the event trace and the game freezing for me for around 100 milliseconds in my experience of playing also backed by the games ingame frametime counter reporting a spike up to around 100 milliseconds gathering this data has allowed me to disprove some myths about what causes stutters in discord myth 1 having hardware acceleration on improves gaming performance false here is a trace showing the stutter occurring while hardware acceleration was on game froze for around 125 ms myth 2 having hardware acceleration off improves gaming performance false in the case of preventing stutters here is a trace showing the stutter occurring while hardware acceleration is off game froze for around 136 ms myth 3 having overlay off improves gaming performance false in the case of preventing stutters here is a trace showing the stutter occurring while the gaming overlay was off game froze for around 130 ms myth 4 not being in a call improves gaming performance false here is a trace showing the stutter occurring while i was not in a call game froze for around 113 ms to make sure this wasnt a vulkan issue i was running the game in vulkan i did another trace in directx 11 once again a stutter occurred at the same time when discord suddenly demanded extra cpu usage game froze for around 79 ms its less than the vulkan stutters but still noticeable as the images show no matter what the settings are discord is causing deadlock to stutter i have created a bug report submitted the five traces to valve through email and am hoping that a solution to this issue can be found

consciousness arxiv230808708 in part 1 i introduced a framework for thinking about machine consciousness scientifically the key insight consciousness is not magic it is architecture neuroscientists have identified specific computational properties that correlate with conscious experience these properties can potentially be implemented in artificial systems today we dive deep into the two most important theoretical frameworks global workspace theory how distributed processors create unified experience higherorder theories how selfmonitoring creates awareness these are not philosophical speculations they are empirically tested theories with decades of experimental support lets break them down the puzzle of unity your brain is not one thing it contains dozens of specialized systems operating in parallel visual cortex processes images auditory cortex processes sounds motor cortex plans movements language areas handle speech these specialists are remarkably good at their jobs they process information rapidly and efficiently most of this processing happens unconsciously you do not experience edge detection algorithms running in visual cortex you experience the result a unified coherent scene here is the puzzle despite all this parallel processing consciousness feels unified you have one stream of awareness not dozens of separate experiences how does distributed processing create integrated experience global workspace theory the architecture global workspace theory gwt provides an answer originally proposed by bernard baars in the 1980s later developed into detailed neural theory by stanislas dehaene and colleagues the core idea is elegant the workspace metaphor imagine a theater many specialists work backstage lighting technicians sound engineers set designers costume makers each specialist does their job independently most of their work happens invisibly to the audience but there is one stage one spotlight whatever enters the spotlight becomes visible to everyone the audience sees it all backstage workers see it too the spotlight is the global workspace how it works in the brain specialized brain modules process information in parallel most of this processing remains unconscious local and encapsulated but some information gains access to a shared global workspace this workspace has limited capacity not everything can enter selection must occur information that wins the competition gets broadcast globally it becomes simultaneously available to all modules everyone sees what is on stage this broadcast creates integration this integration correlates with consciousness the neural evidence this is not just theory extensive evidence supports gwt ignition studies when stimuli cross the threshold from unconscious to conscious perception something dramatic happens neurally dehaene calls it ignition a sudden nonlinear surge of activity across widespread brain networks prefrontal cortex parietal cortex longrange connections lighting up unconscious processing stays local conscious processing goes global single neuron recordings researchers recorded from neurons in monkey prefrontal cortex during binocular rivalry different images shown to each eye create alternating conscious percepts the brain switches between seeing one image or the other prefrontal neurons tracked the consciously perceived image not the suppressed one
